entry.title: OTTmpc 1.0.1
entry.summary: Rebuilt against the updated mpc-vst-plugins wrapper: **Q-Links now move parameters on track edit → automation** (a plain host write no longer makes MPC rebuild its parameter screen; sd88me/mpc-vst-plugins#486). No other changes. `*-mpc-armv7.zip` is for Gen1 MPCs and the Force; `*-mpc-aarch64.zip` is the Gen2 build (MPC OS 3.x), tested offline only. Settings and your own files in the plugin's data folders are kept on upgrade.

entry.title: OTTmpc 1.0.0
entry.summary: # OTTmpc 1.0.0 Vital's OTT multiband up/down compressor ([vitOTTx](https://github.com/Sakhnovkrg/vitOTTx)'s DSP) as an **insert effect** for MPC OS standalone devices, with an OTT-style touchscreen skin, live per-band input/output meters with dB numbers, 12 Q-Link controls and 10 presets in MPC's PRESET menu. ![OTTmpc on a Force](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sd88me/mpc-vst-OTT/claude/friendly-wozniak-m9ak1l/docs/screenshot.png) - Controls: Depth, Time, In Gain, Out Gain, Upward, Downward, M
